response.reason: Both the Nikon D800 body and the AF-S Nikkor 85mm f/1.8G lens are clearly identified from text visible in the photos, but no evidence of power-on, shutter count, or image quality is shown, so the claim of working condition must be priced at worst case (as not working/unverified) until proof is supplied.
